translations.settings.command.name: Command
translations.settings.command.hint.description:
Enter the command/program to use for changing your wallpaper.

Ensure you include the $VP placeholder, which will be replaced with the actual video path when you select a thumbnail.

Example command: /usr/bin/wallpaper $VP
translations.settings.darkMode.name: Dark Mode
translations.settings.darkMode.short.description: Why would you turn this off?
translations.settings.darkMode.hint.description: It's Dark Mode. You know what it does. Why are you even reading this? Just toggle it and embrace the darkness... or the light, if you're into that.
translations.settings.newWallpapers.name: New Wallpapers
translations.settings.newWallpapers.short.description: Search for new wallpapers at startup
translations.settings.newWallpapers.hint.description: Enable this option to automatically search for and load new wallpapers from the selected folder. If disabled, the app will load faster because it won’t spend time searching for new files and generating new thumbnails.
translations.settings.clearThumbnails.name: Clear Thumbnails
translations.settings.clearThumbnails.hint.descriptio:
This will delete all generated thumbnails, usually located at "/home/$USER/.local/share/wallpaper_picker/".

Use this if you have thumbnails that no longer match any videos.

Note: Thumbnails will need to be regenerated after clearing.
translations.settings.deleteConfig.name: Delete Config
translations.settings.deleteConfig.hint.description:
This will delete the configuration file, usually located at "/home/$USER/.config/wallpaper_picker".

Use this to reset all settings to their default values.
translations.settings.language.name: Select Language
translations.settings.language.hint.description:
Select your preferred language from the list.

Don't see yours? Help translate it into your language! Visit the project on GitHub
translations.updater.title: Updates
translations.updater.guidance.manual: In-app installation is disabled for this installation. To update manually, use the matching installer or AppImage from the trusted releases page below.
translations.updater.guidance.unavailable: In-app updating is unavailable for this installation. No update check has been completed.
translations.updater.consent: Update downloads and verifies this version, then closes and restarts the app. Finish your work first; system permission prompts may appear.
translations.updater.guidance.blocked: Installation is paused. Finish pending work and save or discard edits yourself, then retry. Nothing was saved or discarded automatically.
translations.updater.guidance.restart: The update is already installed. Retry only restarts the app; it will not download or install again.
translations.updater.guidance.nix: Use your Nix flake or system configuration to update this app. In-app checks and installation are not available.
translations.updater.guidance.managed: Use the package manager or installation source that owns this app to update it.
translations.updater.guidance.development: In-app updating is disabled in browser and development sessions. No release check was performed.
translations.updater.status.current: No newer version was found at the last completed check.
translations.updater.status.ready: Download verified. Ready to continue the update.
translations.updater.status.handoff: The installer is taking over. The app will close; reopening is handled by the installer.
translations.updater.status.reserved: Update installation in progress. Editing and new actions are temporarily paused.
translations.updater.error.timeout: The request timed out. Retry when the update service is reachable.
translations.updater.error.network: The update service could not be reached. Check your connection and retry.
translations.updater.error.feed: The release feed is unavailable. This does not mean the app is up to date.
translations.updater.error.manifest: The release metadata is invalid. No update can proceed.
translations.updater.error.target: No matching update target is available for this installation.
translations.updater.error.support: Update support could not be confirmed. Use your installation source or the trusted releases page.
translations.updater.error.cleanup: The previous update could not be released safely. Retry cleanup before continuing.
translations.updater.error.signature: Signature verification failed. The downloaded update will not be installed.
translations.updater.error.install: The update could not be installed. Review permissions and finish pending work before retrying.
translations.updater.error.restart: The installed update could not restart the app. Use Retry restart to recover.
translations.updater.error.unknown: The update could not complete. Retry explicitly or use your installation source.
